# ClaimFilter { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter(
    timeline_id=None,
    timeline_ids=None,
    id_pattern=None,
    between=None,
    synchronous_only=False,
    nomatch_only=False,
    include_domains=None,
    include_units=None,
)
```

Reusable filter for querying MatchClaims and related objects.

All fields are optional. When multiple fields are set, they are combined
with AND logic: a claim must satisfy every non-None criterion.

The ``matches_claim()`` method tests a single MatchClaim against all
criteria. The ``matches_timeline()`` method tests a single timeline ID
(used by MatchGraph node-level filtering).

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

Filter for claims involving a specific performer::

    f = ClaimFilter(id_pattern=r"^perf:")
    filtered = [c for c in claims if f.matches_claim(c)]

Filter for synchronous claims between score and one performer::

    f = ClaimFilter(
        between=("score:clt1", "perf:dlt1"),
        synchronous_only=True,
    )

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                                  | Description                                                                                                               |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| timeline_id      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Return claims involving this exact timeline ID.                                                                           |
| timeline_ids     | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                  | Return claims involving any of these timeline IDs.                                                                        |
| id_pattern       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Regex pattern matched against timeline IDs via ``re.search()``. Example: ``r"^perf:"`` matches all performance timelines. |
| between          | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None                | Return claims connecting exactly these two timelines (order-independent).                                                 |
| synchronous_only | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | If True, exclude non-synchronous (NOMATCH) claims.                                                                        |
| nomatch_only     | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | If True, return only non-synchronous (NOMATCH) claims.                                                                    |
| include_domains  | [set](`set`)\[[Domain](`timetoalign.core.enums.Domain`)\] \| None     | Only include timelines in these domains. Requires a ``timelines`` dict for resolution.                                    |
| include_units    | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None | Only include timelines with these units. Requires a ``timelines`` dict for resolution.                                    |

### domain_unit_timeline_ids { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.domain_unit_timeline_ids }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.domain_unit_timeline_ids(timelines)
```

Resolve the domain/unit criteria into the set of ids that pass.

``include_domains`` / ``include_units`` are the only criteria that
need per-timeline metadata. Resolving them once into a plain set of
timeline ids lets a columnar store — which holds ids but no timeline
metadata — apply the same restriction vectorized.

The set carries the same semantics ``matches_claim`` applies: a claim
passes only when **both** of its timelines are in it.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                                 | Description                                     | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timelines | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolution. | _required_ |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                 | Description                                                       |
|--------|--------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | ``None`` when neither criterion is set (no restriction), else the |
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | set of timeline ids satisfying both criteria (empty when          |
|        | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None | ``timelines`` is None, mirroring ``matches_claim``).              |

Convenience constructor mirroring the canonical filter parameter
signature used across the API.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name             | Type                                                                  | Description                                           | Default   |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| timeline_id      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Return claims involving this timeline.                | `None`    |
| timeline_ids     | [set](`set`)\[[str](`str`)\] \| None                                  | Return claims involving any of these timelines.       | `None`    |
| id_pattern       | [str](`str`) \| None                                                  | Regex pattern matched against timeline IDs.           | `None`    |
| between          | [tuple](`tuple`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None                | Return claims connecting exactly these two timelines. | `None`    |
| synchronous_only | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Exclude non-synchronous claims.                       | `False`   |
| nomatch_only     | [bool](`bool`)                                                        | Return only non-synchronous claims.                   | `False`   |
| include_domains  | [set](`set`)\[[Domain](`timetoalign.core.enums.Domain`)\] \| None     | Only timelines in these domains.                      | `None`    |
| include_units    | [set](`set`)\[[TimeUnit](`timetoalign.core.enums.TimeUnit`)\] \| None | Only timelines with these units.                      | `None`    |

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description        |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------|
|        | [ClaimFilter](`timetoalign.alignment.filters.ClaimFilter`) | A new ClaimFilter. |

### matches_claim { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_claim }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_claim(claim, *, timelines=None)
```

Test whether a MatchClaim passes all filter criteria.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                                 | Description                                                                                                                             | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| claim     | [MatchClaim](`timetoalign.alignment.claims.MatchClaim`)                              | The MatchClaim to test.                                                                                                                 | _required_ |
| timelines | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolving domain/unit filters. Required only when ``include_domains`` or ``include_units`` are set. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                           |
|--------|----------------|---------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the claim passes all filters. |

### matches_timeline { #timetoalign.alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_timeline }

```python
alignment.ClaimFilter.matches_timeline(timeline_id, *, timelines=None)
```

Test whether a single timeline ID passes the filter criteria.

Used for node-level filtering in MatchGraph. Only the timeline-ID
related filters are applied (``timeline_id``, ``timeline_ids``,
``id_pattern``, ``include_domains``, ``include_units``). The
claim-level filters (``synchronous_only``, ``nomatch_only``,
``between``) are ignored.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type                                                                                 | Description                                                        | Default    |
|-------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| timeline_id | [str](`str`)                                                                         | The timeline ID to test.                                           | _required_ |
| timelines   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Timeline](`timetoalign.timelines.Timeline`)\] \| None | Dict of timeline_id -> Timeline for resolving domain/unit filters. | `None`     |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type           | Description                                         |
|--------|----------------|-----------------------------------------------------|
|        | [bool](`bool`) | True if the timeline passes all applicable filters. |
